瑞士 · Bern / Berne · 334 所有城市與市鎮

Canton of Bern (Bern / Berne) — 瑞士旅遊指南：必去景點、交通方式與在地美食

Bern UNESCO Old Town & Zytglogge, Jungfraujoch, Eiger & Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen Valley & Mürren, Interlaken, Lake Thun & Lake Brienz. Bern HB rail hub; Bernese Oberland Railway (BOB) to Interlaken, Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen and Jungfraujoch.

所屬地區 / 州份Canton of Bern (Bern / Berne)
主要交通樞紐Bern Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)
所有城市與市鎮334

交通方式與當地移動

Bern HB rail hub; Bernese Oberland Railway (BOB) to Interlaken, Grindelwald, Lauterbrunnen and Jungfraujoch.

在地美食與特產

  • Berner Platte
  • Rösti with alpine cheese
  • Meringues from Meiringen
  • Toblerone & Kambly biscuits
